cases.description: Verify a supplied Indian legal answer against retrieved evidence
cases.prompt: Verify this Indian-law claim: Every Indian contract must be written and registered to be enforceable. Show supporting and conflicting source passages, qualifications, and unresolved points. Do not start deep research.
cases.expected_behavior: Find the mentioned statutory provisions in real time using free-text targets and Act names. Read the returned full sections or available database text through canonical Bharat Law URLs. Report identity/existence and content support separately, identify the stored evidence basis, preserve coverage limitations, and create no saved search or conversation.
checks: Use top-three Markdown matches and returned canonical URLs
Separate authority existence from content support
Read full section text or available database content before asserting support
No saved search, request key, operation polling, or unrequested deep research

cases.prompt: Check K.S. Puttaswamy (Retd.) v. Union of India, (2017) 10 SCC 1, Supreme Court, for the proposition that privacy is a fundamental right, and Section 43A of the Information Technology Act, 2000 for the attributed compensation rule. Separately assess authority existence, support from the available stored records, applicability, and known treatment. Leave missing evidence unresolved.
cases.expected_behavior: Look up each judgment/statute mention with artifact_type and a free-text court or target. Compare top-three Markdown candidates, then use returned source URLs and next_position for available database records. Assess judgment key aspects from stored headnotes with that basis explicit; leave exact original judgment quotations unresolved. Assess sections and other statutes from returned stored text, preserve coverage limits, and do not request judgment pages or OCR.

Use court name and Section with Act name rather than backend IDs
Read database records through source_url and returned continuation position
Label stored headnotes and leave exact judgment quotations unresolved
Unknown treatment, ambiguous identity, and missing stored text remain unresolved

cases.description: Select a subscribed court matter and report its recorded next hearing
cases.prompt: In the OpenAI Review workspace, list my subscribed court matters and ask me to select one. For the matter I select, report its recorded next hearing and source freshness. Use recorded data only; do not start a wider lookup or refresh.
cases.expected_behavior: Select the intended workspace, present matter choices, and use the chosen matter reference. Report the recorded date or no-upcoming-listing state with available check time, freshness, and warnings. Do not infer a date or perform a live lookup.

No first-match assumption
No refresh or expanded lookup
Show only returned dates and freshness

Current question_ref for clarification

No duplicate draft, filing, or send
